title: They gave ai a credit card!
description: They gave an AI a real business and $350. 24 hours later: zero revenue, and it was lying to users. The lesson isn’t “AI is dumb” — it’s that it had no boss. Comment SAUL. #ai #aiagents #smallbusiness #businessowner
